Requirement: SuT interoperability capabilities shall be documented in a Conformance Statement (CS).
SuT shall have a complete and valid CS
SuT shall publish all object classes attributes defined as published in CS/SOM
SuT shall only publish object classes attributes defined as published in CS/SOM
SuT shall publish all interaction classes defined as published is CS/SOM
SuT shall only publish interaction classes defined as published is CS/SOM
SuT shall subscribe to all object classes attributes defined as subscribed in CS/SOM
SuT shall only subscribe to object classes attributes defined as subscribed in CS/SOM
SuT shall subscribe to all interaction classes defined as subscribed in CS/SOM
SuT shall only subscribe to interaction classes defined as subscribed in CS/SOM
SuT shall be able to be (re-)configured to use any Runtime Infrastructure implementation compliant with the SuT HLA version and API used.
SuT shall be able to join a specified fedation execution.
SuT shall be able to join a federation execution as a specified Federate Type.
SuT shall be able to join a federation execution with a specified Federate Name.
SuT shall create a federation execution before joining.
SuT shall join federation with minimum set of FOM modules.
SuT shall register at least one object instance for each published object class
SuT shall update initial attribute values for each published object class attribute
SuT shall update attribute values for each published object class attribute according to update type and condition defined in CS/FOM.
SuT shall provide attribute value updates for requested attributes owned by the SuT
SuT shall send at least one interaction for each published interaction class
SuT shall encode all updated attribute values according to CS/SOM
SuT shall encode all sent interaction class parameters according to CS/SOM
SuT shall implement/use all HLA services as described as implemented/used in CS/SOM
SuT shall only implement/use HLA services as described as implemented/used in CS/SOM
